newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank denies rumour governor may quit.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank denies rumour governor may quit.

text.p: Thailand's central bank on Thursday categoriacally denied market rumours that its governor Rerngchai Marakanond would resign.
"I have been asked to categorically deny these rumours in the market," a senior Bank of Thailand official told Reuters.
There were reports in some small Thai business newspapers that Rerngchai might have prepared his resignation letter and could submit it to the finance minister later on Thursday.

The rumour, which gripped the foreign exchange market early but not the stock market, caused the Thai baht to drop. The baht was quoted at 25.957/962 against the dollar at 0445 GMT on Thursday from around 25.945/950 late on Wednesday after the rumours, dealers said.

The newspaper reports had speculated that Rerngchai might resign in protest against the government's suspension of three Bank of Thailand officials, including deputy governor Jaroong Nookhwun, on Wednesday.

The officials were suspended in connection with their failure to bring former executives of the ailing Bangkok Bank of Commerce to court for violations of the Banking Act, a government spokesman said. Last month prosecutors said they were forced to drop charges against the executives because a one-year statute of limitations had expired.
